liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rubin And Cherise** (1 review): Song marked as a highlight, though the specific recording copy is criticized for poor sound [16]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): The final two minutes feature Jerry playing with a style reminiscent of 1977 performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-17.135339.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 181 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1991-03-17.149664.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 178 min [2]
- **gd1991-03-17.135340.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 181 min [5]
- **gd1991-03-17.135338.upg-sbd.tobin.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 181 min [6]
- **gd91-03-17.sbd.miller.28295.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [11]. Said about its sound: Vince's keyboard work is described as tasteful, while Jerry's guitar performance is on fire; Vince is mixed too loud, burying Jerry's guitar, causing ear pain for the listener; Weir becomes too loud during this song, while Hornsby is almost entirely missing from the mix [19][21][26]
- **gd91-03-17.sbd.munder.8745.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 172 min; rated 2.7/5 by 10 [12]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording lacks bass, has strident highs, and noticeable hiss despite venue quality [15]

## Around the show

- Phil's bass and Bobby's guitar had issues in the first set, resolved in Let It Grow [17]
- Attendees sat on the Vince side midway up, describing it as a happy night for Jerry [24]
- Show exhibits younger Dead qualities, particularly during the China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider jam [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-17.135339.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=8745) SBD>MC>DAT>CDR; via Tom Eliason; Seeded to etree by Willy + AUD (shn id 94062) Master:Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1… [1]. Also: Matrix mix combines 52% soundboard and 48% audience sources, converted to FLAC in 2016 [1]
- **gd1991-03-17.149664.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 23, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: FOB recording used Schoeps CMC3/MK4 mics to DAT, transferred and mastered by Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1991-03-17.135340.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=8745) SBD>MC>DAT>CDR; via Tom Eliason; Seeded to etree by Willy + AUD (shn id 94062) Master:Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics… [5]. Also: DTS surround mix created by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in March 2016 [5]
- **gd1991-03-17.135338.upg-sbd.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16; (original shnid = 8745) SBD>MC>DAT>CDR; via Tom Eliason; Seeded to etree by Willy - pitch correction and patches by Kevin Tobin [6]. Also: Soundboard ran 0.600 seconds per minute fast, requiring speed corrections to the first set [6]
- **gd91-03-17.sbd.miller.28295.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD> Master Dat> Master Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII)> Dat (SV3800/48k); [11]
- **gd91-03-17.sbd.munder.8745.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [12]
